name: Review Slider for WooCommerce
author: jgwhite33

sections.description:
Show WooCommerce Reviews on Your WordPress Site in Minutes.

This plugin syncs your existing WooCommerce product reviews and stores them in your WordPress database on your own server. Your site serves those reviews locally for fast loading and a smooth visitor experience — no external API calls on every page view.

Create a summary review slider or grid that showcases customer feedback across your store. Each review can include the product image and link back to the product page. When a new WooCommerce review is approved, it can be synced into your review list.

Perfect for building trust on your homepage, landing pages, and product pages. Use a shortcode or widget to place reviews anywhere. On a single product page, filter the template to show only reviews for that product.

Feature List:

  • Lightweight plugin code designed for speed.
  • Sync WooCommerce reviews and store them locally on your server.
  • Display reviews in a slider, grid, or rows.
  • Automatically sync when new WooCommerce reviews are added.
  • Show all store reviews or only reviews for the current product page.
  • Mobile-friendly responsive design.
  • Use as a widget or shortcode.
  • Create unlimited review templates for different areas of your site.
  • Customize colors, border radius, show/hide stars and dates, and custom CSS per template.
  • Show only reviews that include text.
  • Sort reviews randomly or by newest.

I personally support all of my plugins and appreciate every customer. If you have any questions, don’t hesitate to ask!

sections.installation:
1. Upload the review-slider-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Open Review Slider in your admin menu.
  4. Go to Sync Reviews to import your WooCommerce reviews.
  5. Visit Review List to confirm reviews were imported.
  6. Create a template on the Templates page and add the shortcode to a post or page.
sections.faq:
Are reviews stored on my server?

Yes. When you sync, WooCommerce reviews are saved in your WordPress database and loaded from your site — not pulled from WooCommerce on every page view.

Do I need WooCommerce installed?

Yes. This plugin displays reviews from your WooCommerce store. WooCommerce must be installed and active.

Can I show only reviews for one product?

Yes. Use the post filter option on your template when placing it on a product page so only that product’s reviews display.

How do I request a new feature?

Post on the support forum or contact us on the WP Review Slider website.
